scripts.harness:smoke: npm run harness:build && node brain/scratchpad/harness/out/run.mjs --profile active --seed 1 --dt 0.5 --capHours 0.5 --lite --out brain/scratchpad/harness/smoke.json && node brain/scratchpad/harness/assert-results.mjs brain/scratchpad/harness/smoke.json --smoke
scripts.harness:full: npm run harness:build && node brain/scratchpad/harness/out/run.mjs --all --seeds 1,2,3 --dt 0.1 --lite --jobs 4 --out brain/scratchpad/harness/results-full.json && node brain/scratchpad/harness/assert-results.mjs brain/scratchpad/harness/results-full.json --full
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run harness:smoke
